text:
omar: Heads-up — HedgeTech is seeing a sudden spike of 502/504s on the /v1/generate hosted endpoint starting ~08:55 UTC. They reported their app got ~30% errors and the SDK retried aggressively -> apparent duplicate traffic.
elaine: Thanks. Do we have their request pattern? small chat messages or long context?
omar: Customer says many short chat turns (avg 120 tokens), heavy concurrency (~200 concurrent requests). They shared a curl that reproduces the failure: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-1","input":"hello","max_tokens":64}'
```
arjun: I pulled edge logs for their tenant between 08:50-09:00. Seeing repeated upstream timeouts: `upstream_read_timeout` and `proxy_connect_timeout` on the edge LB. Many requests hit the same backend pool and then got retried by the SDK, which made the backend queue grow.
support-bot: Incident created: INC-20260316-5892 (latency/timeouts - hosted inference). Assigned to eng-oncall. :rotating_light:
sre-oncall: Quick triage: seems like KV cache lock contention + long-running tokenization spikes on that model variant under many tiny requests. Batching would help but their client pattern is low-latency single-turn chats. We also see the p95 server processing jump from 120ms to 2.6s in the window.
elaine: Can we validate whether the gateway is doing excessive retries? Also check if connection reuse is failing (keepalive resets) — that would amplify load.
arjun: Confirmed a pattern of connection reset: repeated `RST_STREAM` on HTTP/2 + `keepalive_timeout` on the proxy. Some backends hit thread pool saturation and then slow writes -> upstream timeouts.
omar: Customer is on the hosted tier with default client timeout 10s. They said the SDK retried with exponential backoff but no jitter, so retries aligned.
sre-oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) Route their traffic to a healthier backend pool (done, limited window) 2) Enable short-term autoscale burst for their tenancy (requested) 3) Recommend customer increase client timeout to 20s and add jitter to retries.
elaine: I pushed a customer-facing update: "We're routing your requests to a healthier pool and investigating edge keepalive resets. Please increase your client timeout to 20s and add jitter while we stabilize." Waiting for their ack.
omar: Repro steps for eng: run the above curl in a 200-concurrency loop for ~1min to see the error surface. Deck of logs we captured: 
```
[08:56:12] edge: upstream_read_timeout tenant=hedgetech pool=rw-m-p3
[08:56:13] backend: threadpool-exhausted model=rwd-medium-1 in_flight=64
[08:56:14] edge: RST_STREAM id=0x7f tenant=hedgetech
[08:56:15] backend: request-queue-length=512 latency=2.3s
```
arjun: For a longer-term fix: propose increasing per-tenant worker cap for small-turn workloads + smarter request coalescing and jittered retry guidance surfaced in SDK docs. I'll draft a quick config toggle to test.
sre-oncall: Monitoring: added a temporary alert to detect upstream_read_timeout > 5/min for a tenant. Also rolled a one-off kernel tunable on the pool to reduce keepalive timeouts.
omar: Customer responded: "Thanks — we saw errors drop after routing change. We'll patch client to add jitter. Can you confirm if we'll get any billing duplication from the retried traffic?"
elaine: We're running a billing dedupe check — initial look: ~12% of requests were retried and billed twice due to completed-but-retry behavior. Finance flagged it and asked for an itemized CSV.
arjun: I'll export the per-request id logs for their tenant range and correlate to billing IDs. Expect ETA 2-3 hours.
sre-oncall: Next steps for product: add server-side idempotency key support for generate endpoints to avoid double bill on retry when results are identical. Filing a follow-up ticket.
elaine: I'll send the interim customer note with mitigation summary + timeline for billing review. :white_check_mark:
omar: Thanks team. Will monitor INC-20260316-5892 and post any regressions. :eyes:
